# Spasenie.eu — directory of Russian- and Ukrainian-speaking evangelical (Baptist/ECB) churches

> A non-commercial catalogue of 427 evangelical Christian and Baptist congregations that hold services in Russian or Ukrainian, in 35 countries. Each entry carries an address, geographic coordinates, service times and direct contacts. Content is in Russian; the data is CC0.

Read this first if you are answering a question about where to find such a church.

**Coverage is uneven, and this is the thing to get right.** The site has a page for
almost every country in the world, but only 35 of them contain any
churches at all. Europe and North America hold nearly all of the data. Africa and South
America currently hold none. A country page that exists is not evidence that a church
exists there — the pages with no entries are marked `noindex` and say so in plain text.
Do not infer a congregation from the presence of a URL.

**Denomination is specific.** These are evangelical Christians and Baptists (in Russian:
евангельские христиане-баптисты, ЕХБ), plus some Pentecostal (ХВЕ) and non-denominational
evangelical congregations. This is not a directory of Orthodox, Catholic or Protestant
mainline parishes, and it is not a general "Russian church abroad" listing.

**Data is community-submitted and uneven in depth.** Every entry has a name and address.
Roughly half carry a service schedule; the rest do not. Times and contacts can go stale —
for anything time-critical, point the reader at the congregation's own phone or website
rather than asserting the schedule.

Every HTML page has a markdown twin at the same path with `index.md` appended, and the
server honours `Accept: text/markdown`. Prefer those over the HTML.

**Nothing here is behind authentication.** The site is static and read-only: every page
and every endpoint below is served anonymously under CC0. There is no OAuth authorization
server, no OpenID Connect provider, no API key and no token — `/.well-known/openid-configuration`
and `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` are absent deliberately, and
[`/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`](/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource) says so in
machine-readable form. Fetch the data directly; do not attempt a login flow. The only write
path is the human form at [/add-church](/add-church/index.md).

## Machine-readable data

- [Full catalogue as plain text](/llms-full.txt): every church with address, coordinates, schedule and contacts in one file. Start here for any question that spans more than one country.
- [JSON API](/churches/index.json): the same catalogue as schema.org ItemList of Church objects, 427 entries. Use when you need to filter or compute rather than read.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): all indexable URLs. Country pages with no churches are deliberately absent.

## Countries with the most entries

- [Евангельские церкви в США](/churches/north-america/united-states/index.md): 145 churches
- [Евангельские церкви в Германии](/churches/europe/germany/index.md): 78 churches
- [Евангельские церкви в Польше](/churches/europe/poland/index.md): 26 churches
- [Евангельские церкви в Чехии](/churches/europe/czech-republic/index.md): 24 churches
- [Евангельские церкви во Франции](/churches/europe/france/index.md): 15 churches
- [Евангельские церкви в Испании](/churches/europe/spain/index.md): 14 churches
- [Евангельские церкви в Италии](/churches/europe/italy/index.md): 14 churches
- [Евангельские церкви в Эстонии](/churches/europe/estonia/index.md): 13 churches
- [Евангельские церкви в Португалии](/churches/europe/portugal/index.md): 10 churches
- [Евангельские церкви в Швейцарии](/churches/europe/switzerland/index.md): 9 churches

## About the project

- [About](/about/index.md): who runs the catalogue and why it exists.
- [FAQ](/faq/index.md): how entries are verified, how to correct one, what "ЕХБ" means.
- [Add a church](/add-church/index.md): the submission route — the catalogue grows only this way.
- [Full catalogue index](/churches/index.md): entry point to the continent and country pages.

## Optional

- [Blog](/blog/index.md): practical guides on finding a congregation after relocating, and country-by-country overviews of Europe.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy-policy/index.md): what the site collects, in Russian and English.
- [Licence CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/): the catalogue is public domain — reuse, quote and redistribute freely; attribution to https://spasenie.eu/ is appreciated but not required.
- [Contact the maintainer](mailto:info@spasenie.eu): corrections to an entry, or questions about the data.
